representativePositiveSentences.text: All the teachers are PhD holders from top IITs and NITs so they are great at teaching. The course is carefully designed for each department and is very relevant to the corporate market.

Medical facilities are great. We have a separate building for it and a 24x7 ambulance near hostels. We have a very big ground for games. We have a basketball ground and a volleyball court. Inside the hostel, we have a badminton court.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Many times hostel water tank gets empty, so no water, not even for drinking, for hours, and electricity goes sometimes, not much. representativePositiveSentences.text: Placements at NITJ are excellent, with students becoming eligible in the 7th semester; in 2025 the placement rate reached about 92% with over 1000 job offers made. Top recruiters included Google, Microsoft, Amazon, BPCL, Adani, Infosys, Deloitte and Tata Power. The highest B.Tech package touched 52 LPA while the average was around 8.10 lakh per annum; core branches averaged 7 to 8 LPA and CS/IT averaged 13 to 14 LPA. About 86 to 92% of eligible B.Tech students were placed.

In terms of numbers, placement is excellent. For a long time, the campus has been dominated by PSUs and automobile companies. This includes excellent companies involved in core design, the power sector, and the energy sector.

representativeMixedSentences.text: 4-5 senior faculty members are excellent. Every ad-hoc [faculty member] is very poor and useful in [no] way.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Hostels are way better than most of the other NITs. The mess food is good. First-year students get 4-sharing rooms, and from the 2nd year, we get 2[-sharing]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Hostels are not that good and have only fans, not even coolers, so it is difficult in summers. Washrooms are also not well maintained, food is also not that good, overall hostels are very unhygienic and are not well maintained.

Hostel Timing restrictions - One of the worse things I felt at NITJ was restrictive hostel timings. It was up to 10 pm during my time but now it has been raised to 12 midnight for both boys and girls.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: There are 7 standing alone hostels plus Mega Hostels Block A, B, E, F. Standing Alone hostels are numbered as 1-7 and 7E. Hostel 1 & 2 are entirely for first year undergrads. No, freshers will not get a single room unless medically or [via] special allotment.

representativePositiveSentences.text: The library is world-class. There are two libraries in the college, one being the central or old library while the new library is just for study purpose.

Wi-Fi is present throughout the campus. Labs are new and well-maintained. There are two main libraries. The new library is a state-of-the-art construction with a seating capacity of 900ish people at once.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Undergraduate research opportunities are limited, but you can participate in mechanical teams and learn a lot at international-level competitions and race events, or you can start your own.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Cultural & Technical Fest - Utkarsh & Techniti, the cultural & technical fests of NITJ attract colleges from the whole of North India. You get a lot of opportunity to participate in various fun & technical activities during these fests.
No ragging - There is almost no ragging at NITJ. There is separate hostel for 1st year students to stop ragging.
Pros - Friendly ambiance. Seniors are there for support. Ragging is strictly prohibited.

Jalandhar City - The city is itself a students hub. Various other institutes like DAV College, Lovely Professional University, CT College are also situated in Jalandhar. Also the city has all the amenities of a big city but is not overcrowded like Ludhiana or Amritsar... NITJ has an advantage geographically. It is very close to many hill stations and places you can go on during short vacations like Manali, Dharamsala, Rishikesh, Vaishno Devi, Chandigarh, Rohtang etc.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: NIT Jalandhar is a tier 1.5 college only because of its remote location.

representativeMixedSentences.text: We have three messes. The food is above expectations, but is repetitive. It has one of the best sports facilities among all NITs.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The infrastructure here is quite decent. There are old buildings dating back to 1980, and also newer buildings. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, except at hostels, where we have a LAN with good speed. There is a well-equipped international-level library.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Placements are good enough, the bar is raising each year. The AI department is just booming even if it is new. And the oldest department of SVNIT, the mechanical department, is also giving fabulous placements.
The placements are decent in the college. At the start of final year, students are eligible for sitting in placements. Almost 90 out of 120 students in our class got placed.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The professors are decent in some of the departments, and not up to the mark in others. First and second year students are mostly taught by teaching assistants. It is your responsibility to gain knowledge from your teachers.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Here in SVNIT we have awesome hostels for both girls and boys (Best in all the NITs, believe me, even they have accepted it). Girls hostel is Mother Teresa Bhavan, a good ventilated 8 floor hostel, single rooms with delicious mess food.
SVNIT offers decent hostel accommodation. Students are offered single rooms from 2nd year onwards. Mess facilities are good. The food offered is hygienic.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: According to my friends at SVNIT, hostel food is extremely monotonous. It is mostly comprised of Gujarati dishes, which are not liked by them.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Hostel facilities are good for 3rd and 4th-year students, as they have a separate hostel which is the 2nd best hostel on the campus, after the girls' hostel. The first-year hostel is average.

representativePositiveSentences.text: The college has a nice green campus with plenty of space, the classrooms are okay but some of [the] equipment is [old/aged]. The library is great and has a lot of books and very good environment; Wi-Fi is very strong and very good; the infrastructure is really valid.
Facilities are quite good in Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology. Departments are also good. Our college has good Wi-Fi, labs, library and classroom facilities.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: New buildings are good but need a better canteen. It is becoming a need now.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The college gym facility is excellent. The Badminton, Lawn Tennis and Basketball courts are decent. There is a huge Cricket cum Football ground on campus, but it is not maintained properly by the college administration.

Infrastructure including hostels and the library is very good, but the classroom complex, labs, sports complex, student activity centre are not up to the mark. The ground needs a lot of maintenance throughout the year, and courts in particular hostels should be improved.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Overall people are very loving, helpful, and friendly. I just love it.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: Generally a class comprises of around 60-70 students coming from different parts of India. Talking about my class, we are the class of 65 students where there are 13 girls and rest are boys. So it is 1:4 gender ratio.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Students are of all society, it's your way how you get through it, overall no ragging.
The entire campus, including the hostels, have a zero ragging policy.
I had two internships; one in Cadila Ankleshwar and second in GNFC Bharuch. Our college invites various types of companies so not to worry about different field interest.
SVNIT Surat is standing on very vast land of around 250 acres. The most fascinating thing is SVNIT is situated in the posh area of the city Surat.
SVNIT is one of the few NITs with a campus in the city center. Malls, shops, and movie theaters are all located within a 2 km radius.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Connectivity is overall good. The metro is going to start in the upcoming year but the number of trains from Surat to Bihar is still very low, which is a problem during festivals like Chhath Puja.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Placements at NITJ are excellent, with students becoming eligible in the 7th semester; in 2025 the placement rate reached about 92% with over 1000 job offers made. Top recruiters included Google, Microsoft, Amazon, BPCL, Adani, Infosys, Deloitte and Tata Power. The highest B.Tech package touched 52 LPA while the average was around 8.10 lakh per annum; core branches averaged 7 to 8 LPA and CS/IT averaged 13 to 14 LPA. About 86 to 92% of eligible B.Tech students were placed.

In terms of numbers, placement is excellent. For a long time, the campus has been dominated by PSUs and automobile companies. This includes excellent companies involved in core design, the power sector, and the energy sector.

representativeMixedSentences.text: 4-5 senior faculty members are excellent. Every ad-hoc [faculty member] is very poor and useful in [no] way.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Hostels are way better than most of the other NITs. The mess food is good. First-year students get 4-sharing rooms, and from the 2nd year, we get 2[-sharing]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Hostels are not that good and have only fans, not even coolers, so it is difficult in summers. Washrooms are also not well maintained, food is also not that good, overall hostels are very unhygienic and are not well maintained.

Hostel Timing restrictions - One of the worse things I felt at NITJ was restrictive hostel timings. It was up to 10 pm during my time but now it has been raised to 12 midnight for both boys and girls.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: There are 7 standing alone hostels plus Mega Hostels Block A, B, E, F. Standing Alone hostels are numbered as 1-7 and 7E. Hostel 1 & 2 are entirely for first year undergrads. No, freshers will not get a single room unless medically or [via] special allotment.

representativePositiveSentences.text: The library is world-class. There are two libraries in the college, one being the central or old library while the new library is just for study purpose.

Wi-Fi is present throughout the campus. Labs are new and well-maintained. There are two main libraries. The new library is a state-of-the-art construction with a seating capacity of 900ish people at once.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Undergraduate research opportunities are limited, but you can participate in mechanical teams and learn a lot at international-level competitions and race events, or you can start your own.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Cultural & Technical Fest - Utkarsh & Techniti, the cultural & technical fests of NITJ attract colleges from the whole of North India. You get a lot of opportunity to participate in various fun & technical activities during these fests.
No ragging - There is almost no ragging at NITJ. There is separate hostel for 1st year students to stop ragging.
Pros - Friendly ambiance. Seniors are there for support. Ragging is strictly prohibited.

Jalandhar City - The city is itself a students hub. Various other institutes like DAV College, Lovely Professional University, CT College are also situated in Jalandhar. Also the city has all the amenities of a big city but is not overcrowded like Ludhiana or Amritsar... NITJ has an advantage geographically. It is very close to many hill stations and places you can go on during short vacations like Manali, Dharamsala, Rishikesh, Vaishno Devi, Chandigarh, Rohtang etc.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: The hostel life is same as you would experience in other colleges. In NITH, boys change hostels every year and get a new room. Although there are only two hostels for girls, still they get a new room every year.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Hamirpur campus is very beautiful. Also ground is very big. Faculties are very good and supportive. Sports facility and gym facilities are in each hostel.
The girls-to-boys ratio is very good here, and all types of a[ctivities are available]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeMixedSentences.text: There are monkeys in the campus, generally they aren't harmful but sometimes they may harm. The campus is too big so people who walk less may have problems.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Being a first year student at the present, I was also afraid of ragging when I got admission in NIT Hamirpur but the scenario is just the opposite. There is a little introduction thing but that is he[lpful, not harmful]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Self-identified current first-year CSE student describes being 'tagged very badly' along with approximately 20-25 other students by seniors, including being taken to a senior hostel, told to strip at night, and made to run. representativePositiveSentences.text: Here in SVNIT we have awesome hostels for both girls and boys (Best in all the NITs, believe me, even they have accepted it). Girls hostel is Mother Teresa Bhavan, a good ventilated 8 floor hostel, single rooms with delicious mess food.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: According to my friends at SVNIT, hostel food is extremely monotonous. It is mostly comprised of Gujarati dishes, which are not liked by them.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Hostel facilities are good for 3rd and 4th-year students, as they have a separate hostel which is the 2nd best hostel on the campus, after the girls' hostel. The first-year hostel is average.

representativePositiveSentences.text: The college has a nice green campus with plenty of space, the classrooms are okay but some of [the] equipment is [old/aged]. representativeNegativeSentences.text: New buildings are good but need a better canteen. It is becoming a need now.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Overall people are very loving, helpful, and friendly. I just love it.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: Generally a class comprises of around 60-70 students coming from different parts of India. Talking about my class, we are the class of 65 students where there are 13 girls and rest are boys. So it is 1:4 gender ratio.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Students are of all society, it's your way how you get through it, overall no ragging.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Connectivity is overall good. The metro is going to start in the upcoming year but the number of trains from Surat to Bihar is still very low, which is a problem during festivals like Chhath Puja.

representativePositiveSentences.text: In NIT Srinagar campus placement is very good; many companies visit and they offer good packages, highest packages in our college is 40-50 LPA, that is good and many companies like Tata, HCL visit our college.

In my course, the placement percentage was 76%, the highest package was 21 LPA, and the lowest package was 8 LPA with a median package of 10-11 LPA. Top recruiters were Amazon, Flipkart, Deloitte, Infosys, and some PSUs.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Placements are very poor as only 20-30% students get placed with an average package of 6 LPA! Rapid development must be present here which feels bad about this college.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Overall the faculty at NIT Srinagar is good, they provide us with good study material and they have average speaking skills, we can understand their lectures easily.
They all have completed their PhD.

representativeMixedSentences.text: There are a total 5-6 persons in one room in the boys hostel. The quality of food in the mess is better than that in many private colleges. There are full medical facilities and sports and games are also available.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: In NIT Srinagar there are seven hostels for boys and two hostels for girls. These are enough to accommodate both master's and bachelor's students. Hostels are swapped after completion of every even semester. Hostel infrastructure is like every government college, whether it is IITs or NITs.

representativePositiveSentences.text: It has a beautiful campus and the best facilities; the library has a huge amount of books and has free Wi-Fi speed like 100 Mbps.
The facilities of the classroom and library are at the top level. Everything is working and is advanced.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: You may face a terrible internet connection or communication issues once in a blue moon as per instructions of authorities and circumstances in Kashmir Valley.' This reflects periodic, externally-imposed connectivity disruptions specific to the region's security context, reported factually rather than editorialized.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Srinagar is one of the oldest and best institutes in North India after IIT Roorkee, PEC Chandigarh, NIT Kurukshetra and NIT Jalandhar. The institute has excellent faculty, infrastructure as well as a very scenic campus... provides effective engineering education at par with various other NITs.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: If you are getting any other NIT, I will prefer you to join that NIT. But if not and NIT Srinagar is the only choice, then join it as [the] NIT tag is sufficient.' Comparative, lukewarm-but-not-negative framing.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Ragging is not a very big issue at NIT Srinagar. But one cannot say that it is 100% ragging free. Seniors (2nd year students) generally [tell] first year students to wear formals f[or a period]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet), indicating mild introduction-style practices rather than severe hazing.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: There are no on-campus internships; you have to find one your own and let college know about it. They put restrictions on [going off-campus]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

When I received the admission to NIT Srinagar, my family and I were filled with sadness. We had read about the incidents of terrorism in Kashmir in the newspaper, and just a few days ago, two soldiers had lost their lives in a terrorist attack. People at home would often tell me...' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet). This reflects the student's reported initial apprehension about the region's security situation prior to arrival, not a claim about ongoing campus conditions.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: Regarding the situation here, all that happens outside the campus. But the study gets affected.' This directly distinguishes campus-internal academic life from the broader regional situation while still noting some impact on studies.

representativePositiveSentences.text: The placement of the college is good. The placement and training committee plays a very important role during the placement round... representativeNeutralSentences.text: The placement of the college is just okay. In comparison to many other NITs, the placement is just average.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Faculty-student ratio in NIT Arunachal Pradesh is good, it is almost 20 teachers per 100 students. Most teachers are Ph.D. holders and [have] minimum 10-year experience. And for lab work facility [there] is a Ph.D. student. Exam levels are moderate.

High-quality bed facilities, great hostel, every room have its own balcony and you will get fresh air and beautiful greenery of mountains. All students were very happy in this college; very good facilities compared to other colleges.
The food served in the mess is good.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Fooding quality is not so good. The hostel is run by the hostel mess in-charge who made a contract with the college and runs the mess. Hostel fee is free but mess fee is not. Mess fee is around Rs 3500 per month.
Medical facilities are not good.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Overall, NIT Arunachal Pradesh offers satisfactory campus life. Hostel facilities are decent. The campus has two hostels for girls. Rooms are spacious. The hostel has 24 hours Wi-Fi and LAN facilities. The mess food won't be satisfactory in terms of taste but it is hygienic and clean.' Separately: 'It all depends upon which hostel is assigned to you. If you are lucky you might get to live with 2-3 students or you will [live] with at least 7 students in a single room.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Library facilities are available but very poor and also transportation facilities in college is very poor.
During winter season, there is acute shortage of water in campus and students suffer from this situation every year, due to which academic calendar is revised sometimes.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The infrastructure of academic buildings is not bad. But you will be disappointed if you place high hopes on infrastructure. In hostels, we get almost all the facilities. The only things that concern us are power cuts and connectivity. Only BSNL works there, so to use the internet, we need to depend solely on Wi-Fi.

Infrastructure related to studies is good but medical facilities and sports curriculum still need improvement. There is improvement of canteen facilities and mess food quality but it still requires more [work]. The construction of [the] central library is ongoing and it has one library that is functional.

representativePositiveSentences.text: The cultural activities here are the best; you can celebrate many festivals including [the] Arunachal local fest.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: There is no students' society but students gather if there is a mass need.

representativeMixedSentences.text: There are two college fests, Addovedi the technical fest and Atulyam the cultural fest. As the campus has recently shifted, these fests don't meet most of the students' expectations.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Arunachal Pradesh does not have a ragging culture. The institute has strict restrictions and policies for ragging, and also has an Anti-Ragging Squad. At the time of admission, students have to sign the affidavit regarding the ragging [policy].

representativeNegativeSentences.text: The major drawback of this college is connectivity. If you need to buy anything, most of the time you need to go to Itanagar. There are only two buses to Itanagar, and the timings are bad. There are no buses in college. So while going to classes, you will be walking down the hill. On Sunday, there is no transport. As of now, we can say that connectivity is the worst.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: I don't like the curriculum because it is so outdated and it's mostly focused on theoretical knowledge and not industry ready.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Sports facilities of our college is also very good, our new sports complex makes it amazing... clubs like Shaurya for sports.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Placements are very good and one of the best for core branches with 90+ placement rate; even the core branches placement rate are 85+.

The college is very prestigious and placement is superb, most of the students placed in final year. The environment of the college is good and laboratory is very good for practical. All the faculty is well qualified and the teaching style is superb.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The placements are good enough for students in NIT Hamirpur. But, it requires more than [being] a NITian to get good placement. You should be curious about learning things in the whole period of your B.Tech. Also, your CGPA should be above 8... Good CGPA can increase your chances to get a placement but not guarantee your placement.

The percentage of students who have been placed this year is approximately 96 percent and last year it was 100 percent. However only 3 to 4 students got a 20 LPA or 24 LPA package and the remaining all got a 5 LPA package which is why I gave 3 stars.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: The professors are not the best, you might find great professors at NIT Hamirpur but most of them are just the typical government job employees trying to pass time.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Faculty members are good. You need to be regular in classes. Almost all students pass the exams. The syllabus here is somewhat scattered. We need to connect them to become industry-ready.

representativePositiveSentences.text: There are very good-quality hostels in our institute. There are a total of 13 hostels at the National Institute of Technology, Hamirpur. The quality of food in our hostel is very good and hygienic. Mess workers are cooperative, and night canteens are present in every hostel. A hospital is also present in our institute.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: The hostel life is same as you would experience in other colleges. In NITH, boys change hostels every year and get a new room. Although there are only two hostels for girls, still they get a new room every year.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Hamirpur campus is very beautiful. Also ground is very big. Faculties are very good and supportive. Sports facility and gym facilities are in each hostel.
The girls-to-boys ratio is very good here, and all types of a[ctivities are available]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeMixedSentences.text: There are monkeys in the campus, generally they aren't harmful but sometimes they may harm. The campus is too big so people who walk less may have problems.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Being a first year student at the present, I was also afraid of ragging when I got admission in NIT Hamirpur but the scenario is just the opposite. You don't seem to have ragging; it's like you give respect to seniors, they respect you. There is a little introduction thing but that is he[lpful, not harmful]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Self-identified current first-year CSE student describes being 'tagged very badly' along with approximately 20-25 other students by seniors, including being taken to a senior hostel, told to strip at night, and made to run. This is a serious allegation of hazing/ragging that directly conflicts with multiple other accounts on the same platform describing NIT Hamirpur as ragging-free or minimally so.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Placements are very good and one of the best for core branches with 90+ placement rate; even the core branches placement rate are 85+.

The college is very prestigious and placement is superb, most of the students placed in final year. The environment of the college is good and laboratory is very good for practical. All the faculty is well qualified and the teaching style is superb.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The placements are good enough for students in NIT Hamirpur. But, it requires more than [being] a NITian to get good placement. You should be curious about learning things in the whole period of your B.Tech. Also, your CGPA should be above 8... Good CGPA can increase your chances to get a placement but not guarantee your placement.

The percentage of students who have been placed this year is approximately 96 percent and last year it was 100 percent. However only 3 to 4 students got a 20 LPA or 24 LPA package and the remaining all got a 5 LPA package which is why I gave 3 stars.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: The professors are not the best, you might find great professors at NIT Hamirpur but most of them are just the typical government job employees trying to pass time.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Faculty members are good. You need to be regular in classes. Almost all students pass the exams. The syllabus here is somewhat scattered. We need to connect them to become industry-ready.

representativePositiveSentences.text: There are very good-quality hostels in our institute. There are a total of 13 hostels at the National Institute of Technology, Hamirpur. The quality of food in our hostel is very good and hygienic. Mess workers are cooperative, and night canteens are present in every hostel. A hospital is also present in our institute.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: The hostel life is same as you would experience in other colleges. In NITH, boys change hostels every year and get a new room. Although there are only two hostels for girls, still they get a new room every year.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Hamirpur campus is very beautiful. Also ground is very big. Faculties are very good and supportive. Sports facility and gym facilities are in each hostel.
The girls-to-boys ratio is very good here, and all types of a[ctivities are available]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeMixedSentences.text: There are monkeys in the campus, generally they aren't harmful but sometimes they may harm. The campus is too big so people who walk less may have problems.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Being a first year student at the present, I was also afraid of ragging when I got admission in NIT Hamirpur but the scenario is just the opposite. You don't seem to have ragging; it's like you give respect to seniors, they respect you. There is a little introduction thing but that is he[lpful, not harmful]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativePositiveSentences.text: Placements are very good and one of the best for core branches with 90+ placement rate; even the core branches placement rate are 85+.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The placements are good enough for students in NIT Hamirpur. But, it requires more than [being] a NITian to get good placement. You should be curious about learning things in the whole period of your B.Tech. Also, your CGPA should be above 8... Good CGPA can increase your chances to get a placement but not guarantee your placement.

The percentage of students who have been placed this year is approximately 96 percent and last year it was 100 percent. However only 3 to 4 students got a 20 LPA or 24 LPA package and the remaining all got a 5 LPA package which is why I gave 3 stars.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: The professors are not the best, you might find great professors at NIT Hamirpur but most of them are just the typical government job employees trying to pass time.

representativeMixedSentences.text: Faculty members are good. You need to be regular in classes. Almost all students pass the exams. The syllabus here is somewhat scattered. We need to connect them to become industry-ready.

representativePositiveSentences.text: There are very good-quality hostels in our institute. There are a total of 13 hostels at the National Institute of Technology, Hamirpur. representativeNeutralSentences.text: The hostel life is same as you would experience in other colleges. In NITH, boys change hostels every year and get a new room. Although there are only two hostels for girls, still they get a new room every year.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Hamirpur campus is very beautiful. Also ground is very big. Faculties are very good and supportive. Sports facility and gym facilities are in each hostel.
The girls-to-boys ratio is very good here, and all types of a[ctivities are available]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeMixedSentences.text: There are monkeys in the campus, generally they aren't harmful but sometimes they may harm. The campus is too big so people who walk less may have problems.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Being a first year student at the present, I was also afraid of ragging when I got admission in NIT Hamirpur but the scenario is just the opposite. There is a little introduction thing but that is he[lpful, not harmful]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Self-identified current first-year CSE student describes being 'tagged very badly' along with approximately 20-25 other students by seniors, including being taken to a senior hostel, told to strip at night, and made to run. representativePositiveSentences.text: The placements here [are] up to the mark and are only improving every year. Some of the companies that visit NITM are Microsoft, Amazon, HP, L&T, Powergrid, MasterCard, Nissan, etc. The institute also boasts an impressive 100% placement rate.
Around 100% is the placement percentage. The salary package is 12 LPA. Top companies are P&G, Caterpillar, etc. Around 50% of students got internships. The top roles offered are data analysts.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: The placements at NIT Meghalaya have been very average, or even below average, for the last two to three years. This year's placements were rather dull, and no big IT companies participated in the on-campus hiring session. Most of the students who got good packages either got them off-campus or had PPOs from their internships.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Students are less in number so the overall experience is good. Passing is not a big deal. However, you must secure 30 out of 100 in end term exam. Teachers are excellent but they focus more on your higher studies and promote you to do so. Rarely 1-2 students ever fail.

Professors are very good and helpful. You can contact them at any point. The curriculum is not that hard and one can pass even by studying for one day; grading is relative so it's easy to pass. Easily you can get good marks of 8 CGPA which is enough from a NIT.

The hostel facility here at NIT Meghalaya is very good. The hostels are spread in various parts of the city, with a majority of hostels being in the Lapalang area. The hostels are well equipped with various kinds of facilities like TV Room, gym, sports room etc. As a bare minimum, in each room, you'll get a bed, table, chair and a locker, one for each of the students living in the room.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Hostels are far from college and are average. All the hostels are at different places and are not good. Even the quality of food served is the worst. You can't enjoy hostel life but from batch '23 we are shifting to permanent campus, so then it will be good.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: Hostels are not inside the campus, however a new campus is being built which will be functional in 2025. Hostels are owned by the college.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Currently, we are operating from Shillong, and it is a temporary campus. Our campus is average so the college life is not that good.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The college has decent infrastructure with good facility and machines. But has less number of faculties with not so good faculties in some subjects.

Till now NIT Meghalaya [is] on its temporary campus, so the campus area is not too large and hostels are within the range of 10 km from the campus, but bus facilities are there for transportation. Other than that every facility is available on the campus. Most importantly campus is well-cleaned and very beautiful.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Meghalaya is a decent institute as far as studies are concerned. You will have ample chance to study and learn new stuff; being a new institute you get a lot of stuff and initiatives to be done and handled single-handedly, which gives another chance not only to learn and show[case skills]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

I couldn't stop myself from writing this answer. Whenever I find the questions related to my college I feel very amazing. I have spent one of the best parts of my life here in this institute and most probably I won't get that kind of life again. There are ample of memories [made here].
NIT Meghalaya is definitely a good choice if you are not getting any older NITs. All the students here enjoy their life and are safe inside hostel.

Being a MeghNITe, it was always a cutting edge for me in interviews and people used to literally appreciate the exposure I had even from being a remote located college of India (though it was not pretty different to what a normal NITian would have had in other NIT).

representativePositiveSentences.text: Students are less in number so the overall experience is good. Passing is not a big deal. However, you must secure 30 out of 100 in end term exam. representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Meghalaya is a decent institute as far as studies are concerned. NIT Meghalaya is definitely a good choice if you are not getting any older NITs. All the students here enjoy their life and are safe inside hostel.

Being a MeghNITe, it was always a cutting edge for me in interviews and people used to literally appreciate the exposure I had even from being a remote located college of India (though it was not pretty different to what a normal NITian would have had in other NIT).

representativePositiveSentences.text: The placements here [are] up to the mark and are only improving every year. This year the highest international package was around 82 LPA and the highest domestic package was around 42 LPA. Some of the companies that visit NITM are Microsoft, Amazon, HP, L&T, Powergrid, MasterCard, Nissan, etc. The institute also boasts an impressive 100% placement rate.
Around 100% is the placement percentage. The salary package is 12 LPA. Top companies are P&G, Caterpillar, etc. Around 50% of students got internships. The top roles offered are data analysts.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: The placements at NIT Meghalaya have been very average, or even below average, for the last two to three years. This year's placements were rather dull, and no big IT companies participated in the on-campus hiring session. Most of the students who got good packages either got them off-campus or had PPOs from their internships.

representativePositiveSentences.text: Students are less in number so the overall experience is good. Passing is not a big deal. However, you must secure 30 out of 100 in end term exam. Teachers are excellent but they focus more on your higher studies and promote you to do so. Rarely 1-2 students ever fail.

Professors are very good and helpful. You can contact them at any point. The curriculum is not that hard and one can pass even by studying for one day; grading is relative so it's easy to pass. Easily you can get good marks of 8 CGPA which is enough from a NIT.

The hostel facility here at NIT Meghalaya is very good. The hostels are spread in various parts of the city, with a majority of hostels being in the Lapalang area. The hostels are well equipped with various kinds of facilities like TV Room, gym, sports room etc. As a bare minimum, in each room, you'll get a bed, table, chair and a locker, one for each of the students living in the room.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Hostels are far from college and are average. All the hostels are at different places and are not good. Even the quality of food served is the worst. You can't enjoy hostel life but from batch '23 we are shifting to permanent campus, so then it will be good.

representativeNeutralSentences.text: Hostels are not inside the campus, however a new campus is being built which will be functional in 2025. Hostels are owned by the college.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: Currently, we are operating from Shillong, and it is a temporary campus. Our campus is average so the college life is not that good.

representativeMixedSentences.text: The college has decent infrastructure with good facility and machines. But has less number of faculties with not so good faculties in some subjects.

Till now NIT Meghalaya [is] on its temporary campus, so the campus area is not too large and hostels are within the range of 10 km from the campus, but bus facilities are there for transportation. Other than that every facility is available on the campus. Most importantly campus is well-cleaned and very beautiful.

representativePositiveSentences.text: NIT Meghalaya is a decent institute as far as studies are concerned. You will have ample chance to study and learn new stuff; being a new institute you get a lot of stuff and initiatives to be done and handled single-handedly, which gives another chance not only to learn and show[case skills]' (sentence truncated in retrieved snippet).

I couldn't stop myself from writing this answer. Whenever I find the questions related to my college I feel very amazing. I have spent one of the best parts of my life here in this institute and most probably I won't get that kind of life again. There are ample of memories [made here].
NIT Meghalaya is definitely a good choice if you are not getting any older NITs. All the students here enjoy their life and are safe inside hostel.

Being a MeghNITe, it was always a cutting edge for me in interviews and people used to literally appreciate the exposure I had even from being a remote located college of India (though it was not pretty different to what a normal NITian would have had in other NIT).

representativePositiveSentences.text: Placement of NIT Mizoram is good. 80 to 90% of students are placed. The average package is 8 LPA, and many companies are visiting the campus like Wipro, TCS, Infosys, etc.
Last year, more than 90 percent of students were placed. Right now, the highest package is 21 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package is 9 LPA.

Faculty members are supportive. Students' skill development often gets prioritized over other work. You can literally grab knowledge from professors in classes, they don't hesitate to tell even the basics to students.
The Institute has hostels, proper mess, sports facilities, classrooms which can accommodate more than 70 students with proper seats. The hostel and mess are clean and hygienic.

representativeNegativeSentences.text: We pay the hostel and mess fees every sem; it's total about 40000. I think the hostel and mess fees is very high and the quality of the food they provide is not good at all.

Since it doesn't have [a] permanent campus, all the blocks are placed at least 1 km far. No playground is there. Girls' hostel is 12 km away from college and boys' hostel is 7 km away. All year girls stay in [the] same hostel but boys have separate hostels for [a] particular year.
